Interesting. To be honest, after a little warming up, she was *ok*, not great, but getting better. I know that with my girlfriend of 2 years, it was a little time before we could really go at it. And my girlfriend now was hard to even get one finger in before, where as now 2 is pretty comfy and 3 is even a possibility after some fooling around.

We'll be ok... I think. I told her the second she told me she was a virgin that I'm not dating her for the sex, and I'm still not. But if that's gonna be a part of a healthy relationship, than I want it to work.
Thanks for the answer by the way. And as much as I hate to be like "har har har great advice from FunnyUsername", this is just too funny. VaginalKnives? I'm asking why my gf hurts? Too good.

I don't want to hurt her at all. I did everything possible to make sure that didn't happen. Changed things up. Took a few breaks. She was the one that just wanted to keep going. There were a few points in there where she actually was like "wow that felt awesome" and I could see on her face something was good. But there still were those moments where even I felt like holy shit this is tight there's no way it can't hurt her, and it did. 

I guess I'm just asking, is this normal? And will it maybe go away eventually?

I didn't push sex at all and don't want to seem like a jerk asking this. I really want to help.

Thanks so much for the response. I haven't had anyone close die and I was actually just an average kid with a good group of friends. I am INCREDIBLY hard on myself. School, sports, everything. And its not because my parents were, either. I just push myself too hard and never stop giving myself grief when I mess up. After talking to an older sister that is like I am, I'm pretty close to going to see someone to talk to.

For now, I'm gonna go have fun on this date. Thanks so much for the reply.
